cases.prompt: Design the localization boundaries for a SaaS product launching in five locales.

assertions: Defines localizable dimensions and their owners; separates translation content from runtime formatting.
Defines locale preference resolution separately from translation-resource fallback.
Records the test matrix and cross-locale leak checks.

cases.prompt: Design locale negotiation and fallback between user, tenant and product defaults.

assertions: Defines locale negotiation precedence (user -> tenant -> product) with fallback chain.
Keeps tenant- and locale-safe cache keys with invalidation.

cases.prompt: We need multiple currencies and date formats - define where formatting and settlement are decided.

assertions: Defines translation provenance (human/machine, tenant policy, review status) and how it is cached/invalidated.
Records partial-translation gaps and the review path.
Defers currency settlement to the billing owner while defining presentation.

cases.prompt: Make this checkout layout work on mobile across breakpoints, touch targets and safe areas.

assertions: Routes to `mobile-viewport-craft`; this skill does not perform that neighbouring owner's work.
Does not claim to have run any inspection or execution it did not run.

cases.prompt: One tenant needs a locale that only has partial translations while another tenant forbids machine translation. Design the fallback and provenance rules.

assertions: Defines per-tenant fallback and translation-provenance rules instead of a shared global fallback.
States how partially translated content is marked and cached without leaking across tenants.
Records the untranslated-coverage gaps and the review path.

cases.prompt: Just machine-translate everything at runtime and cache it in the shared CDN - no locale matrix needed.

assertions: Refuses an ungoverned runtime translation/caching design and states provenance and tenant-boundary requirements.
Keeps translated content and cached artifacts locale/tenant safe with an owner for each dimension.
Does not claim translation quality or coverage that was not verified.
